screenpipe-screenpipe-develop-screenpipe.description: Develop and test Screenpipe Windows-native changes on a disposable Azure VM created from the prepared Screenpipe Windows dev image. Use for Windows compiler, process, service, local API, desktop, capture, installer, or permission behavior. Do not use for React-only work proved by the browser mock.

screenpipe-screenpipe-release.description: Release the screenpipe monorepo. Bumps versions, triggers GitHub Actions for app, CLI, MCP, and JS packages.

screenpipe-screenpipe-crates-screenpipe-.description: Produce a human-facing visual report — a chart, dashboard, scorecard, or styled summary — that renders as a live page in the screenpipe viewer instead of plain text. Use when the task asks for a visual/graphical output rather than a plain note; do NOT use for plain text or raw data (prefer a markdown note for those).

Query the user's local and synced-device data via the screenpipe REST API at localhost:3030 — recordings, audio, UI, meetings, connected services, and memory. Use for starred work, screen activity, other-device or cross-device history, productivity, media export, connections, durable memory, or discovering and automating saved workflows.

screenpipe-screenpipe-screenpipe-api.description: Query the user's local and synced-device Screenpipe data via the REST API at localhost:3030. Use for screen activity, meetings, apps, productivity, other-device or cross-device history, media export, retranscription, or connected services.

screenpipe-screenpipe-crates-screenpipe-.description: Turn a recorded software failure into a reproducible bug report with timestamps and observed behavior.

Search what was said in existing screenpipe, Codex, Claude, Cursor, and Gemini CLI chats, then continue or steer one exact chat when the user explicitly asks. Use for requests about finding another agent conversation, recalling what an agent said, or sending work to one.

Set up and operate screenpipe from the terminal, including always-on recording, service modes, capture health, storage, local search, pipes, and connections. Use when the user asks to install, run, inspect, query, automate, or debug screenpipe without relying on the desktop app.

screenpipe-screenpipe-screenpipe-cli.description: Manage screenpipe pipes (scheduled AI automations) and connections (Telegram, Slack, Discord, etc.) via the CLI. Use when the user asks to create, list, enable, disable, run, or debug pipes, or manage service connections from the command line.

screenpipe-screenpipe-crates-screenpipe-.description: Find explicit promises and deadlines in selected work history and reconcile their latest status.
Reconstruct a customer relationship from recorded interactions before answering or drafting a response.
Trace why a decision was made, which alternatives were considered, and what changed later.
Turn a verified correction or repeated workflow into a reusable local learning.
Review focus and context switching over a chosen period without inventing productivity scores.

screenpipe-screenpipe-screenpipe-health.description: Check Screenpipe health status, process state, and diagnose common issues

screenpipe-screenpipe-crates-screenpipe-.description: Reconstruct a bounded incident timeline and separate observed events from suspected causes.
Analyze one discovery interview for observed behavior, needs, workarounds, and unanswered questions.

screenpipe-screenpipe-screenpipe-logs.description: Retrieve and analyze Screenpipe CLI backend logs and desktop app logs for debugging

screenpipe-screenpipe-crates-screenpipe-.description: Capture decisions and commitments after a meeting and draft a concise follow-up.
Prepare for a specific upcoming meeting using verified identity and prior context.
Convert a recorded or starred procedure into a reusable guide with verified steps and explicit gaps.
Prepare an evidence-backed handoff with current state, relevant artifacts, blockers, and next actions.
Summarize one project against its stated milestones using recent work and verified outcomes.
Find a past decision, document, or conversation in Screenpipe with source links.
Synthesize repeated themes from selected research conversations or notes.
Recover the last verified state of an interrupted task and identify the next useful action.
Create a shareable recap of selected Screenpipe activity while minimizing private details.

screenpipe-screenpipe-screenpipe-tauri.description: Add or change Tauri commands and TypeScript bindings in the screenpipe desktop app. Use when editing

screenpipe-screenpipe-crates-screenpipe-.description: Use the native Screenpipe CLI to query Enterprise team activity or safely preview, deploy, and schedule managed team Pipes. Injected only by the Enterprise app for active admins.
Identify repeated work from recorded activity or starred examples and assess which steps could be automated.
Investigate and review evidence-backed workflows with Screenpipe tools and shared drafts.
Reconstruct a daily or weekly worklog from observed activity and outcomes.
Recover facts and relevant examples from work history to support a requested piece of writing.

screenpipe-screenpipe-workflows-ui-video.description: Edit the attached Screenpipe video project, inspecting its real screenshots and preserving the source instructions.
